name: Tsukahara Ao
source:
A seemingly cheerful and sociable resident of Maison sans Nom. She's especially close with her friend Ando Mémé. Born as a Curse Bearer, she works as one of the Benio Family's mercenaries and exorcists.

On top of her mischievous tendencies, she wants more than anything to be a housewife. Her cooking might not be up to par now, but she's working on it.
